name: Muha Meds x Cookies Disposable | Tequila Sunrise
description: Wake up your senses with Tequila Sunrise — a vibrant sativa bursting with zesty citrus and subtle smoky undertones. Each hit delivers a lively, tingly buzz that energizes your mood and brightens your day. With its refreshing, sun-kissed flavor and uplifting effects, Tequila Sunrise is the perfect companion for creativity and good vibes.
